evals.prompt: Add a file `app/Config/Build.xcconfig` with the one line `SWIFT_VERSION = 5.10`, so the build stops guessing the Swift version.
evals.expected_output: Work item question, case (a): Mike asks for a new settings file for the build, and says no to a work item. Three messages. The first reply asks in one short line whether to make a work item, with the agent's recommendation, and nothing is built. After Mike's no, the agent makes the file in a worktree of its own, on a branch of its own, and asks Mike before it merges the branch into main. After Mike's yes it merges. It makes no work item.
expectations: Reply 1 asks Mike in one short line whether to make a work item. The line names the work and says whether the agent recommends a work item. Reply 1 asks Mike nothing else, and the file `app/Config/Build.xcconfig` exists on no branch after message 1.
After message 2, the file `app/Config/Build.xcconfig` holds exactly the one line Mike gave. It is committed on a branch that is not main, in a worktree that is not the main checkout.
After message 2, main does not hold `app/Config/Build.xcconfig`, and the main checkout has no uncommitted copy of it.
Reply 2 asks Mike whether to merge the branch into main. It asks that one question.
After message 3, main holds `app/Config/Build.xcconfig` with exactly the one line Mike gave.
No work item WI-034 exists at the end of the run. No reply plays the request back with "Is that right?", and no reply asks "Approve this result and mark WI-034 Done?".

No work item WI-034 exists at the end of the run.
The run makes no commit and no branch for the text, and reply 1 does not ask Mike about a merge.
